android_mechanism: UI state (paint) updated when nothing visually changed; fix skips redundant updates
bug_description: The now-playing page assigns the raw millisecond position from AVPlayer's timeUpdate callback into a page-level @State on every callback (~10/s). The whole player page (cover image, title, slider, controls) re-renders at callback frequency although the slider position and time labels only visibly change once per second, wasting UI-thread CPU throughout playback.
fix_summary: The state is assigned only when the whole-second part of the position changes.
trigger_steps: Play a track and stay on the now-playing page.
Start hitrace capture (categories: ace, app, sched, graphic).
Let it play untouched for 60 seconds.
Stop hitrace. Repeat 3 repetitions for unfixed, then install the fixed HAP and repeat 3 repetitions.

test_oracle.definition: Count of page state updates / render passes attributable to currentValue during 60s idle playback, plus UI-thread CPU time.
test_oracle.comparison: unfixed ~600 updates/minute vs fixed ~60/minute; unfixed UI CPU during playback > fixed.

trace_config.command: hdc shell hitrace --time 70 ace app sched graphic -o /data/local/tmp/yt_timeupdate.chtrace
